meta.title: VisionQuest — Our Fan-Made Post-Credits Scene: Doctor Doom Saves the Scarlet Witch | Don't Spoil It RG
meta.source: Original fan script by Claude for Don't Spoil It RG. Not a scene from VisionQuest. Canon labels only for facts from released MCU films/series and confirmed release dates.

scenes.name: After the credits

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: VisionQuest just ended. But what if one more scene played after the credits?

spoken: Vision Quest just ended. But what if one more scene played after the credits?
scenes.note: Our own post-credits idea — not in the show

scenes.name: Wundagore

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mount Wundagore. Snow falls on the ruins where it all collapsed.

spoken: Mount Woonda-gore. Snow falls on the ruins where it all collapsed.
scenes.note: Wundagore — Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)

scenes.name: The collapse

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Here, Wanda brought the mountain down on herself in Multiverse of Madness.

scenes.note: Wanda destroyed the Darkhold and Wundagore collapsed on her (2022)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But deep beneath the rubble, a scarlet glow is still flickering.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Footsteps crunch through the snow. A green cloak. An iron mask.

scenes.name: Doom arrives

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Doctor Doom has come to Wundagore, and he did not come by accident.

spoken: Doctor Doom has come to Woonda-gore, and he did not come by accident.
scenes.note: Doom's MCU debut is Avengers: Doomsday (Dec 18, 2026)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: With one raised hand, he lifts tons of stone into the air.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There she is. Wanda Maximoff, barely breathing, her power almost gone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Doom kneels and presses his gauntlet to her forehead. Green runes pour in.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her eyes snap open, glowing red.

lines.speaker: doom
lines.text: Because the multiverse is ending, and I need the Scarlet Witch.

scenes.name: Vision feels it

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Far away, Vision opens his eyes. He felt that. Wanda is alive.

scenes.note: Invented scene · Doom arrives in Avengers: Doomsday, Dec 18, 2026
